findings.issue: Session reset could discard revocation tracking.
findings.resolution: Reset executes durable logout revocation; preserves proof/session identifiers/outbox until receipt or verified owner resolution.

findings.issue: Bespoke signature serialization conflicted with accepted standard-scheme requirement.
findings.resolution: RFC9421 ecdsa-p256-sha256 and RFC9530 sha-256 profile; signed request bindings, nonce window, duplicate rejection and changed-payload idempotency denial.

findings.issue: Unscoped plaintext invariant conflicted with explicit export/framing exceptions.
findings.resolution: Internal-sensitive-content invariant and explicit DEC017 bounded export exception.

validator_review: One 13-path successor after pinned baseline; protected Recovery tree, receipt, provenance, historical status and prior CI gates retained.
limitations: Architecture only; full candidate CI is a publication gate.
Root/OS compromise, active unlocked session, software Keystore and flash remnants remain documented risks.
No production security certification or runtime acceptance.

remediation_review.scope: Owner-selected Google account/device separation, mandatory App Lock, offline invariants, exact CI provenance fetch order and bounded single remediation successor. Historical review above is preserved.
remediation_review.limitation: Fresh remote-object preflight and exact-SHA full CI remain external publication gates.
